title: Record: what each line of a list came to, and who signed it
description: The answers to one revision of one list on one job. Lines are keyed by the list's line_id. A record never restates the requirement; it points at it.

source.description: Where the record's content came from, when it was not a live job.

capture_sign_off.description: The mission's existing sign-off: nothing is open and the operator signed once. Null until then.

via.description: How it reached the bridge, as the mission records it: web UI, asked in the chat, relayed by the agent.

agent.description: Who proposed or computed it, as specs/control-plane.md part B asks. client, model and plane are declared, not verified.

status.description: open: nothing captured. not_yet and does_not_fit: the bridge's own verdicts, with its reason. answered: the evidence carries the line. declined: a person or the agent closed it without an answer, with a reason.

conformance.description: Only with answered. conforming and non_conforming: the evidence against the line's tolerance or requirement. neutral: answered, but the tolerance makes no call for this case. not_applicable: the line asks for a figure or a record, not a pass. The four states are the ones field inspection software already uses.

reason.description: Why not yet, does not fit, declined or neutral, in the bridge's words where it has them.

say.description: The bridge's sentence, relayed as written (specs/any-agent.md part A).

reading.description: The figures, by the bridge's field names (out_of_plumb_mm, over_m, flat_rms_mm, …).

pictures.description: Links to the views in the field web UI or the report.

document.description: With attested: the document the statement rests on.

live.description: False when the answer was worked out from finished scans, not asked during the visit.

place.description: Where the line was bound on site.

action.description: done: the party says the work is finished. witnessed: the party attended. released: a hold point is lifted. accepted, accepted_with_note, rejected: the party's call on the answered line.
